AssetCreatedGmt.description_en: The creation time of the business knowledge. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
AssetCreatedGmt.description_zh: 业务知识的创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

AssetDescription.description_en: The business knowledge content of the table
AssetDescription.example: 保存订单及其关联业务信息。

AssetModifiedGmt.description_en: The last modification time of the business knowledge. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
AssetModifiedGmt.description_zh: 业务知识的最近修改时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

DbType.description_en: The database type. For example, mysql indicates MySQL
DbType.description_zh: 数据库类型，例如 mysql 表示 MySQL

Description.description_en: The table comment in the CREATE TABLE statement

EnvType.description_en: The environment type of the instance

HotLevel.description_en: The knowledge popularity level. A value of 0 indicates that no popularity score is available. Values from 1 to 5 indicate popularity levels from low to high
HotLevel.description_zh: 知识热度等级。0 表示尚无热度评分，1～5 表示由低到高的热度等级

Level.description_en: The knowledge level. This parameter is used to distinguish the generation, confirmation, and lock statuses of the knowledge. A value greater than 3 indicates the locked status
Level.description_zh: 知识等级。用于区分知识的生成、确认及锁定状态；大于 3 时对应锁定状态

LevelType.description_en:
The knowledge status. Valid values:
to_completed: To be supplemented.
to_verify: To be verified.
verified: Verified.
verify_failed: Verification failed.
is_delete: Deleted.
unlocked: Unlocked.
locked: Locked
LevelType.description_zh: 知识状态。to_completed：待补充；to_verify：待认证；verified：已认证；verify_failed：认证失败；is_delete：已删除；unlocked：未锁定；locked：已锁定

Logic.description_en:
Specifies whether the table is a logical table. Valid values:
true: The table is a logical table.
false: The table is a physical table
Logic.description_zh: 是否为逻辑表。true 表示逻辑表，false 表示物理表

NumRows.description_en: The number of rows in the table

SchemaName.description_en: The schema name of the database
SchemaName.description_zh: 数据库的 Schema 名称

Size.description_en: The storage capacity of the table. Unit: MB
Size.description_zh: 表的存储容量，单位为 MB

Summary.description_en: The summary of the business knowledge for the table

Title.description_en: The business title of the table

description_en: Searches for tables across databases at the tenant level using natural language and returns a list of table knowledge entries
description_zh: 租户级自然语言全局找表，返回表知识列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise search-tenant-table-knowledge --query '帮我找一下用户订单相关的表' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchTenantTableKnowledge

parameters.help_en: The natural language description for searching tables
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The name of the model to use. Only Qwen series models are supported
parameters.help_zh: 选用的模型名称，仅可用千问系列
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The database ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, tables are searched within the specified database. If not specified, tables are searched across all databases at the tenant level
parameters.help_zh: 数据库ID，可选。传入时在指定库内找表；不传时为租户级跨库找表
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of table knowledge entries to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回表知识条数上限，默认20，最大50
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The session ID. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: session_id

Data.description_en: The list of table knowledge entries

items.description_en: The paginated result of table knowledge entries

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
